title: Recording with Cottrell and Dixieland Hall; Kid Thomas
summary: Playing guitar with Cottrell, Paul Barbarin at Dixieland Hall, and Kid Thomas's routines.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: I was with Cotter when he first started out. They had a recording couple come down here and record it. He wanted him. Well, I was playing guitar then. I got the album riding in some way. Well, we'd been high, you know, just a long time. I played with him with Paul Bobbler. When he had the Dixie Land Hall on Boyle Street, I know you can remember that. He was with that. And, and he was with the band, with the Puyon band, like I told you. and he was playing songs there, I played the wrong time, but it all come back to me. Okay,

that man probably can bring you back to some well songs way back. I tell you that, the routines over there, he was open with the ensemble. He started with the trombone, trombone to the clarinet, finally to the tenor sax, the tenor sax, the man you par on, and then the meeting. See, by the time, that's three or four quarters. If I don't know, he said, well, the fourth, the second, or the third one, I done got it. I cut it out of the meeting, took a solo. I see him looking at me. He said, well, you thought I couldn't make it, but I made it.
